title: Effect of Drainage on Laparoscopic Gastric Bypass Surgery
brief_summary: Introduction RYGB surgeon; Have become increasingly morbid obesity treatment methods with improvements in minimally invasive surgery. Ensuring patient comfort and early return to life are the criteria that should be given priority in this treatment method. The purpose of this study is to determine the use of drain, which closely affects these criteria; And the effect on patient comfort.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Morbid obese patients

Exclusion Criteria:

* Cirrhotic patients, those under 18 years of age, additional intraabdominal surgeries during LRYGBP and those who had previously undergone obesity surgery (revision surgery) were excluded
